events.text:
The plan has four phases. The 28x37 map is mostly water, and I traced the route by hand against the rules; I could not run it.

**Why mirrors alone cannot work.** Both mirrors face west, so every teleport moves a thing along a (+1,+1) or (−1,−1) diagonal, which keeps x−y constant. The door has x−y = 6. The bottom island tops out at −4, the middle island at 0, and the door island starts at 5. The trader therefore needs walkable cells at x−y = 1, 2, 3 and 4. No floor cell has those values, so I must build four sunk-crystal stepping stones. The map has only one crystal, so I use the mirrors to copy it.

1. **Cross to the middle island.**
   - I push mirror #2 west twice to (14,23).
   - I walk to (19,23) and press `X`. The trader is seen 5 cells east of the mirror and lands on (14,18).

2. **Set up the crystal factory.**
   - I push mirror #4 west to (12,18).
   - I push the crystal from (14,16) to (14,18).
   - With the trader at (11,16), pressing `X` makes both mirrors see that crystal. Mirror #4 sends one copy to (12,16). Mirror #2 sends the other to (19,23).
   - A second `X` brings the (19,23) crystal back to (14,18), and a third `X` copies it again.

3. **Build the bridge up column 17.**
   - I push each crystal east along row 16. The first sinks at (17,16).
   - Later crystals are pushed into (17,16), then north from (17,17). They sink at (17,15), (17,14) and (17,13) in turn.

4. **Cross to the door.** From (17,13) I step to (17,12) and then east onto the door at (18,12).
